title: AI Instagram Post Generator
summary: Free AI Instagram post generator: describe your post and get square or portrait images, text graphics and short vertical reel clips, with the prompts to copy.
body_markdown:
### Can AI make Instagram posts?


Yes. An AI image model can make a finished post from a written description of the subject, styling, light and frame, including product photos, food shots, outfit photos, announcement graphics with short text and illustrated quotes.


### Is there a free AI Instagram post generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, enough to make several posts and animate one into a short reel clip.


### What size should an AI Instagram post be?


Generate feed posts in a square 1:1 or a portrait 3:4 frame, which shows larger in the feed, and reels and stories in a vertical 9:16 frame, then name that shape in the prompt so nothing important sits at the edges.


### Can AI put text on an Instagram post?


Yes. Write the exact words in quotes, name the lettering style and ask for them spelled exactly as written; keep it to a short headline and one line, because long paragraphs are easier to add as a caption.


### Can I make posts that look like my brand?


Yes. Keep the same colours, light and styling words in every prompt, and add earlier posts or product photos as reference images in Flick, so every new post matches the rest of your feed.


### Can I make Instagram reels with AI?


Yes. Make a vertical still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model and describe one simple motion, and add music when you post it or generate a track in Flick.
